source_text.body:
Dispute contractor pricing and change orders
An AI reviewed a contractor PO, emails and line items and drafted dispute emails, spotting issues the user missed and leading to $20K credited back.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
User fed the AI every line item, the PO, and all contractor emails. The AI reviewed them and drafted detailed dispute emails on pricing and change orders, including challenges the user had not spotted. The user sent the emails with little further input.
How it went
The disputes produced $20K credited back over the project life.
Worth knowing
Required little effort on the user's part.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Review the contractor purchase order, emails and line items in [folder path] for my [project]. Compare what was quoted with what was billed and the change orders, and list every discrepancy with amounts and the evidence. Draft a dispute email for each issue in my voice, but don't send anything. Finish with a summary of the total I could dispute.
Original source: https://x.com/AddictedHoosier/status/2105711009327456547
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

introduction.en: The central mechanism is document comparison followed by a human-sent dispute. The source does not identify the actual agent; Claude Cowork appears only as a recommended trial tool.
introduction.zh: 核心机制是比对文件后由人发送异议。源站未标明实际agent名称；Claude Cowork只是推荐试用工具。

method.en: The user supplied purchase-order terms, individual charges and the contractor email history. The AI cross-reviewed this material for pricing and change-order disagreements, then prepared detailed emails, including objections the user had overlooked. The user sent those drafts with little additional input.
method.zh: 用户提供采购订单条款、逐项费用和承包商邮件历史。AI交叉审阅报价及变更单争议并生成详细邮件，其中包含用户此前忽略的异议；用户少量补充后自行发送。

outcome.en: The source attributes $20,000 in credits to disputes across the project’s lifetime. That is an aggregate project adjustment, not a single-message result or a recurring revenue figure.
outcome.zh: 源站将项目期间累计两万美元抵扣归于这些争议。这是整个项目的累计调整，不能写成一封邮件的结果或持续性收入。

notes.en: The short account provides neither a breakdown of credited items nor a measure of review time. It therefore supports a reported outcome and a document-to-draft workflow, while leaving causality, effort and reproducibility unresolved.
notes.zh: 简短叙述没有给出抵扣项目明细，也未测量审阅耗时。因此它能提供的是结果声称及“文件到草稿”的流程线索，因果关系、实际投入和可复现性仍未解决。

editorial.attribution: Original structured synthesis of source-reported facts and explicit evidence limits; not full text, a full translation, or independent outcome verification.
editorial.quotation_policy: No source quotation needed; tool names, numbers and interface command tokens retained as facts.

translation.body:
就承包商报价与变更单提出异议
AI审阅了承包商采购订单、邮件和逐项费用，并起草争议邮件，发现用户遗漏的问题，最终带来两万美元抵扣。
实际使用
自建或未命名agent
具体做法
用户向AI提供了全部逐项费用、采购订单及所有承包商邮件。AI审阅这些资料，为报价与变更单争议起草详细邮件，其中包括用户此前没有发现的质疑点。用户几乎没有再补充内容就发送了邮件。
结果如何
这些争议在整个项目期间带来了两万美元的累计抵扣。
值得知道
用户投入的精力很少。
自行试用
推荐工具
Claude Cowork
复制提示词
审阅[文件夹路径]中有关我的[项目]的承包商采购订单、邮件与逐项费用。比较原报价、实际账单和变更单，列出每项差异、金额及证据。用我的口吻为每个问题起草争议邮件，但不要发送任何内容。最后汇总我可以提出争议的总金额。
原始来源：https://x.com/AddictedHoosier/status/2105711009327456547
